title: Add a bulk-order discount
description: Extend the synthetic order calculation with an optional discount in integer percentage points. Preserve the existing two-argument call behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Calling calculate_total with two arguments returns the original total in cents.
Discount values range from 0 through 100; invalid values raise ValueError.
Discounted totals use integer arithmetic and round down to whole cents.
Regression tests cover default, discounted, boundary, and invalid inputs.
